text: Morning all. Who can bring a spade and fork to the working party on Sat? The big bed by the gate needs turning over before the frost gets in 🥶
I can bring a fork. Spade's in the van but I can bring it Sat if no deliveries clash. What time?
ooh i've got a spade but its my mums old one can bring that!! what time is it?
Ten suits me. We'll be done by one for tea
Sanjay if you can make it half ten that'd be grand, I'm at the dentist first
Got two forks. I'll bring a spade too. Will be there for nine if the gate's open
Ten is fine as well, I'm not quick first thing
Can do a spade. Sorry, only just seen this, been buried in year-end for the hall hire
Also before I forget, do we want to book the hall for the spring plant sale again? Last year they were gone by mid Feb
Yes please. Sanjay, can you ask Gwen at the hall? She likes you
Will do. Tuesday mornings she's usually there
can i help w the plant sale?? i can do the cake stall
We made a fair bit on the tables last time, didn't we
£212 on the tables, cake stall was about £60. Not a bad year
ill make a list of what we need for cakes
No need to apologise Hannah, it's lovely to have the enthusiasm 🌿
